name: new-effect-atom
title: Create Effect Atom
description: Create an effect atom with a demo and settings. Add optional CSS declarations that use shared project tokens.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Atom Name
settings.description: Atom name; effect- is added once. Repeated leading prefixes are collapsed.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated effect atom; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated effect atom.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Atoms Folder
settings.description: Parent folder that will contain the new named atom folder.

settings.name: styles
settings.title: Effect Styles
settings.description: Optional CSS declarations using shared tokens, without selectors or braces.

settings.name: name_prefix
settings.description: Optional namespace prefix placed before the category, such as test-action-name.
